common: Animate the provided start frame, a 3D animated feature film scene. Keep the exact look of the start frame: the same characters, faces, clothing, props with their printed labels, the warm library reading room, the lighting and the colour grade. Style: polished CGI animation look with subtle fabric creases, soft subsurface skin, gentle natural motion, stable facial identity throughout.
neg: morphing or changing text, distorted hands, extra fingers, flickering textures, identity drift, exaggerated movement, camera shake, new objects appearing, realistic photo style

shots.1: Scene: a quiet university library table in soft morning daylight. Action timeline: the young woman in a dark grey hijab and brick-red cardigan (Vidka) lifts the thick stack of paper slightly and beams, speaking a short excited sentence, her shoulders bouncing once with joy. The older man with short grey hair and a trimmed grey beard in a light-blue shirt (Herry) smiles warmly and raises an open palm in a gentle wait gesture, then lowers it and speaks a short calm sentence, nodding toward the stack. Both settle, Vidka still smiling. Camera: locked-off medium two-shot at eye level with a very slow, barely perceptible push-in, shallow depth of field.
shots.3: Scene: top-down view of two printed pages lying side by side on a honey-coloured wooden table, soft daylight. Action timeline: a hand at the right edge holding a yellow pencil slides into frame, the pencil tip traces slowly along the highlighted phrase on the left page, pauses, then moves across to the highlighted phrase on the right page and taps it twice, then rests. The pages stay flat and legible, the printed words never change. Camera: static overhead shot with a very slow drift downward, shallow depth of field at the corners.
shots.4: Scene: over-the-shoulder view from behind the young woman in a dark grey hijab (Vidka) toward the man with glasses and a thick moustache in an olive shirt (Ardipal) across a library table with three printed articles and a notebook. Action timeline: Ardipal sweeps his open hand slowly across the three articles from left to right, then taps the notebook once and looks up, asking a short question with raised eyebrows. Vidka's head tilts slightly as she listens, then she leans forward a little toward the articles. Both settle. Camera: locked-off over-the-shoulder shot with a very slow push-in, shallow depth of field.
shots.5: Scene: close-up of an open laptop on a library table showing a 2 by 2 grid of four small rehearsal-room video thumbnails, one outlined in yellow. Action timeline: the older grey-bearded man in a light-blue shirt (Herry) leans in from the left and points at the yellow-outlined thumbnail, then speaks a short question, glancing at the young woman. The young woman in a dark grey hijab (Vidka) on the right leans closer to the screen, squints slightly, then her eyes widen a little in realisation. Inside the thumbnails the tiny figures move almost imperceptibly. Everything else holds still. Camera: locked-off close-up with a very slow push-in toward the screen, shallow depth of field.
shots.6: Scene: a library table with three spiral-bound transcripts in blue, beige and green standing upright, soft daylight. Action timeline: the young woman in a dark grey hijab and brick-red cardigan (Vidka) holds up a small white quotation card, smiling, and tilts it slightly toward the man beside her. The man with glasses and a thick moustache in an olive shirt (Ardipal) turns his open hand upward in a questioning gesture and asks a short question, eyebrows raised, then glances down at the three transcripts. Vidka's smile fades into a thoughtful look as she follows his glance. Both settle. Camera: locked-off medium two-shot at eye level with a very slow push-in, shallow depth of field.
shots.7: Scene: over-the-shoulder view past the young woman in a dark grey hijab (Vidka) toward a laptop showing a simple two-row table, with an open notebook headed Interpretasi beside it, and the older grey-bearded man in a light-blue shirt (Herry) on the left. Action timeline: Herry rests his chin on his hand, studies the table, then lifts his head and speaks a short calm question while gesturing softly toward the screen. Vidka raises her hand to her cheek, thinking, then turns her head slightly toward the notebook. The table on the screen stays unchanged. Both settle. Camera: locked-off over-the-shoulder shot with a very slow drift to the right, shallow depth of field.
shots.8: Scene: top-down view of an open book on a wooden table, the same phrase circled in red on both pages and joined by a red arrow, a yellow sticky note at the lower right. Action timeline: a hand holding a dark pen enters from the right, hovers over the circled phrase on the left page, follows the red arrow slowly across to the circled phrase on the right page, then taps the yellow sticky note twice and rests. The printed text, the red circles and the arrow never change. Camera: static overhead shot with a very slow drift upward, shallow depth of field at the edges.
shots.9: Scene: close-up of the young woman in a dark grey hijab and brick-red cardigan (Vidka) in profile at a library table, writing in a notebook headed SARAN, the older grey-bearded man in a light-blue shirt (Herry) softly out of focus in the background. Action timeline: Vidka writes slowly, her pen moving along the line beneath the yellow-highlighted words, she pauses, lifts her eyes toward Herry, and gives a small nod. In the background Herry, blurred, rests his chin on his hand and smiles, his head tilting slightly as he speaks a short gentle question. Vidka returns to writing. Camera: locked-off close-up with a very slow push-in, shallow depth of field.
shots.10: Scene: a library table with an open laptop whose screen shows two text boxes, the lower one highlighted yellow, soft daylight. Action timeline: the young woman in a dark grey hijab and brick-red cardigan (Vidka) laughs lightly, covering a smile with the back of her hand, and glances at the laptop. The man with glasses and a thick moustache in an olive shirt (Ardipal) opens his hand toward the screen in an explaining gesture and speaks a short question with a warm half-smile, then taps the table lightly. Vidka nods, still smiling. The text boxes on the screen stay unchanged. Camera: locked-off medium two-shot at eye level with a very slow push-in, shallow depth of field.
shots.11: Scene: close-up over a library table of an open book with a yellow tab, a quotation card and a navy book titled Pedoman Kampus. Action timeline: the older grey-bearded man in a light-blue shirt (Herry) points to the yellow tab inside the open book, slides his finger slowly down the page, then looks up at the young woman and asks a short question. The young woman in a dark grey hijab (Vidka) leans in closely, her eyes following his finger, then she glances at the navy book and back. The printed labels never change. Both settle. Camera: locked-off close-up with a very slow push-in, shallow depth of field.
shots.12: Scene: a warm ending at a library table in soft golden daylight, the young woman in a dark grey hijab and brick-red cardigan (Vidka) in the middle holding the revised stack of paper, the older grey-bearded man in a light-blue shirt (Herry) on the left and the man with glasses and a thick moustache in an olive shirt (Ardipal) on the right. Action timeline: Vidka lifts the stack a little, smiles confidently and speaks a short determined sentence, giving one firm nod. Herry chuckles softly and nods back, Ardipal's serious expression warms into an approving smile as he nods once. All three settle, smiling. Camera: locked-off medium three-shot at eye level with a very slow, gentle push-in, shallow depth of field.
